SCR-CMP-C1.name: Over the shoulder
SCR-CMP-C1.layers: room plate, device shadow, device frame, UI sheet, glass reflection, caret and selection overlay
SCR-CMP-C1.safe_area: Lyric bounding box inside the central 84% x 80% of the frame (title-safe), plus the player-chrome-safe zone (bottom 14% in the app stage).
SCR-CMP-C1.assets: UIK, FRM device, ENV room, TEX glass, REV caret, CAM handheld and push

SCR-CMP-C2.name: Macro on the field
SCR-CMP-C2.layers: UI sheet (blurred), field crop sharp, caret overlay
SCR-CMP-C2.assets: UIK states with large fields, REV caret and selection, CAM push

SCR-CMP-C3.name: Desktop windows
SCR-CMP-C3.layers: wallpaper, back windows (2-4), front window, cursor, glass
SCR-CMP-C3.safe_area: Front window field inside central 80% x 70%.
SCR-CMP-C3.assets: UIK desktop kits (documents, code editor, retro desktop, mail), FRM laptop and monitor, PRC wallpaper

SCR-CMP-C4.name: Thread scroll
SCR-CMP-C4.layers: thread background, bubbles, input bar, keyboard, overlay
SCR-CMP-C4.assets: UIK messaging, notes and voice memo states, PRP notifications and stickers

SCR-CMP-C5.name: Two screens
SCR-CMP-C5.layers: room A, room B, device A, device B, UI sheets, glass
SCR-CMP-C5.safe_area: Each device's field in its half's central 80%.
SCR-CMP-C5.assets: UIK messaging and notes, FRM two device types, ENV two rooms

SCR-CMP-C6.name: Lock screen
SCR-CMP-C6.assets: UIK lock screen kit, PRC wallpaper, PRP notifications

SCR-CMP-C7.name: Full-frame terminal
SCR-CMP-C7.layers: terminal background, text sheet, CRT curvature and scan post
SCR-CMP-C7.safe_area: Prompt line inside central 90% width; never on the bottom 14% (player chrome).
SCR-CMP-C7.assets: UIK terminal kit, TEX CRT plates, MOT typing

attributes.subject: comments and strings
attributes.motion: typing in a line of code

SCR-UIK-APP.name: Fictional app kits
SCR-UIK-APP.compatible_with: Device frames of the matching class; typing profiles; notifications of the same device world.
SCR-UIK-APP.exclusions: Never two kits of different OS design languages in one song; terminal kits never with stickers.

SCR-UIK-STA.name: Kit states
SCR-UIK-STA.compatible_with: Typing profiles; transitions send-scroll and app-switch.
SCR-UIK-STA.exclusions: Upcoming lyric lines may appear only in states that declare a "suggestion" slot and only for timed lyrics.

SCR-FRM-DEV.name: Device frames
SCR-FRM-DEV.compatible_with: Kits of the matching device class.
SCR-FRM-DEV.exclusions: Hand silhouette only with phones and tablets.

SCR-ENV-ROM.name: Room plates
SCR-ENV-ROM.compatible_with: Phones, tablets, laptops; not CRT (CRT uses its own dark room).
SCR-ENV-ROM.exclusions: Never two practical lights of different temperatures in one plate.

SCR-PRC-WAL.name: Wallpaper generators
SCR-PRC-WAL.exclusions: Cover crop wallpapers are not used in the Post and caption family (the cover already appears unmodified there).

SCR-PRP-NTF.name: Notifications and system overlays
SCR-PRP-NTF.compatible_with: Kits of the same device world.
SCR-PRP-NTF.exclusions: Max 1 on screen besides Halo stack; never over the lyric field.

SCR-PRP-STK.name: Original reaction stickers
SCR-PRP-STK.exclusions: Never in terminal, code editor, old desktop; never on sad or grief identity unless chosen.

SCR-REV-CAR.name: Caret, selection and correction overlays
SCR-REV-CAR.exclusions: Selection sweep and autocorrect never on estimated words; no squiggles in complex scripts.

SCR-MOT-TYP.name: Typing behaviour profiles
SCR-MOT-TYP.exclusions: Typo-bearing profiles disabled for complex scripts and estimated timing (typos only in Latin, line or authored).

SCR-MOT-TPO.name: Typo models
SCR-MOT-TPO.exclusions: Never for non-Latin scripts, never in the last word of a line, never in a hook's first appearance.

SCR-CAM-CAM.name: Camera moves
SCR-CAM-CAM.exclusions: No camera move during the last 300 ms of a line's typing; no handheld in reduced motion.

SCR-LAY-FLD.name: Lyric field treatments
SCR-LAY-FLD.compatible_with: All kits declare which treatment they use.
SCR-LAY-FLD.exclusions: No treatment may place the lyric under 2.2% x-height in output pixels.

SCR-PRC-META.name: Metadata content rules
SCR-PRC-META.exclusions: No rule may produce text that is not the title, artist, album, a sung line, song time or a line number.

SCR-TEX-GLS.name: Glass and CRT surface plates
SCR-TEX-GLS.exclusions: Glass smudge never with CRT; nothing over the lyric field above 4% opacity.

layer_order: wallpaper (PRC wallpaper, only lock and desktop)
UI sheet: kit state (UIK) with earlier lines
active field with lyric and caret (REV)
post: grain, focus blur, motion blur, CRT scan for terminals

invalid.because: Cover must be shown unmodified (Spotify artwork policy).

invalid.never_with: portrait small mobile with both full devices
invalid.because: Fields become too small; use the receiver banner instead.
Only when chosen or the lyric is about code.

limits.scale: Lyric x-height floors as in typography; device never smaller than 55% of the frame height in landscape; notifications never larger than the lyric field.
limits.safe: Lyric box in the title-safe 84% x 80% and outside the bottom 14% player-chrome zone; overlays never intersect the lyric box (layout solver pushes them to the opposite half).
limits.complexity: Max 6 visible UI widgets besides the lyric field; max 1 overlay; max 2 devices.
limits.colour: One theme per device world; accent from cover; stickers use accent or complementary only; room plate tinted by the theme spill.
limits.motion: Only one of camera push, whip pan or scroll per 600 ms window; no camera move during the last 300 ms of a line's typing.
limits.material: CRT plates only with terminal and old desktop kits; glass smudge never with CRT; hand silhouette never with desktop monitors.
